name: Image & Text Watermarking Durability Benchmark
description: A benchmark suite that measures the durability and robustness of image and text watermarks under common corruptions, transformations, and adversarial attacks.
notes: Multimodal, non‑LLM benchmark focused on watermark resilience; results can vary widely by corruption type and watermark scheme. Potential dataset/tooling heterogeneity and limited standardization across attack types.
